번역: Even though students read the same book, they all imagined different things regarding the content, background, and direction, and drew different images inside their heads. Literature delivers various information exclusively through language. Therefore, it is necessary to understand objects that have never been seen before through abstract linguistic expressions. At this time, students who possess different experiences and background knowledge each came up with different directions, that is, different concrete images through their respective imaginations even after reading the same book. Through this, it can be seen that imagination allows various interpretations and images to come to mind from the same linguistic expression and delivery.
